lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Have you heard about the new event coming to Coin Rush?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: We've been thinking of what could be a unique prize.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Something like Noir and I granting a customer one wish.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: What do you think?
Isn't that a bit broad?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Unrealistic wishes aren't allowed.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: We've also set a condition that we can only grant wishes that we know we're able to fulfill.
I think the customers will love that.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Me too, hehe.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: The announcement was only made a few days ago,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but we're already being flooded with wish requests.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: There was one in particular

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: that really threw me for a loop.
Did someone ask if they could marry you?
What is it?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Haha! There were a few of those,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but we of course filed that

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: under our unrealistic wish category.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: The wish was

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: to have Noir and I

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: wear reverse bunny suits.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: But we have always been wearing bunny girl costumes.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Why did they make such a strange wish?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Do you know

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: what the "reverse bunny suit" is?
This wish is also unrealistic.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Is it?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: So you know what the reverse bunny suit is, don't you?
Sorry, but I have something urgent to get.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Ahhhhhhhhh, Pit Boss!
I should refrain from contacting Blanc for a while.
